transcription: My roommate wakes up every night at 3 a.m. to speak Latin to Alexa. I made the mistake of asking why. All right, I need to get this off my chest because it's starting to freak me out. I've been living with my roommate for about six months now. Seemed like a totally normal guy quiet, polite, into books and old movies. Bit of a nerd, but nothing alarming. Then, about a month ago, I started waking up around 3 a.m. every night because of this weird, low voice. At first, I thought he was watching TV or listening to a podcast. But it kept happening always around 3.0 3 to 3.0 5. So one night, I get up and walk toward the living room. What I see. My roommate. Standing straight up. Eyes closed. Speaking fluent Latin to Alexa. Stuff like Domina Alexa, Audi Volentata Mayam. Lux Tenebris resist a. Silio Tempus. And the creepiest part? Alexa was responding. In Latin. In a Lego. Or to Closysund. Noley Timeier. For the record Alexa doesn't speak Latin by default. I checked. You can't even really set it to Latin officially. So next morning, I casually ask him, hey man, were you up late last night talking to Alexa or something? And he goes, totally calm no. I'm always asleep by midnight. I just stared at him. Didn't push it. The next night I set my phone to record audio. Result 52 minutes of what sounds like an interrogation. Latin back and forth between him and Alexa. Like he was summoning something or asking her questions about. I don't even know. I translated one line he kept repeating of servo custodium. Apparently it means I'm watching the guardian. I don't know what the hell that means, but it doesn't sound great. A few nights ago, I tried waking him up during it. Bad idea. He turned toward me eyes open, but I swear he wasn't seeing me and he said nullitate tundrae portum. Do not touch the door. Then Alexa just. Shut off. No lights. Dead. Like, physically wouldn't turn on anymore. He won't talk to me now.
